gain.label: Level
gain.hover: The overall loudness of the sound. Range 0 to 100.

pres_lin.label: Dynamics (even)
pres_lin.hover: The even part of how pressure becomes loudness: more here and a light touch already speaks. Range 0 to 1.

pres_sq.label: Dynamics (curved)
pres_sq.hover: The curved part of how pressure becomes loudness: more here and the loud end opens up faster than the soft end. Range 0 to 1.5.

pres_hz.label: Response
pres_hz.hover: How quickly the sound follows a change of pressure: low is a slow swell, high is immediate. Range 2 to 200 Hz.

release.label: Release
release.hover: How long the sound takes to die away after the key is released. Range 0.005 to 1 s.

rel_pedal.label: Release with pedal
rel_pedal.hover: How much longer the release gets with the sustain pedal down. Range 0 to 3 s.

p_soft.label: Breath, soft
p_soft.hover: The blowing pressure at the lightest touch, relative to where the tone just speaks: above 1 it always speaks, below 1 a light touch is only air. Range 10 to 3000.

p_loud.label: Breath, loud
p_loud.hover: The blowing pressure at a full press: higher is louder and brighter, and pushes the tone harder. Range 20 to 6000.

p_reg.label: Breath by register
p_reg.hover: How the blowing pressure changes going up the range: above 0 the high notes get more air. Range -0.5 to 2.

p_curve.label: Breath curve
p_curve.hover: The shape of the curve from key pressure to blowing pressure: below 1 soft playing is easier, above 1 the loud end comes later. Range 0.3 to 3.

theta.label: Jet timing
theta.hover: The jet's timing at the edge, relative to the note's period: 0.5 is the sweet spot. Range 0.03 to 2.

theta_reg.label: Jet timing by register
theta_reg.hover: How the jet timing changes per octave up. Range -1 to 1 octaves.

w_track.label: Lips follow breath
w_track.hover: How much the player shortens the lip distance with the breath: 1 keeps the jet timing. Range 0 to 1.

jet_h.label: Lip opening
jet_h.hover: How thick the jet is: the lip opening. Range 0.2 to 3 mm.

h_loud.label: Opening when loud
h_loud.hover: How much the lips open with the breath. Range -1 to 2 octaves.

jet_w.label: Jet width
jet_w.hover: How wide the jet is. Range 2 to 20 mm.

g_soft.label: Jet gain, soft
g_soft.hover: How much the jet feeds the tone at the lightest touch: 1 just speaks, more is surer. Range 0.3 to 20.

amp_loud.label: Jet gain, loud
amp_loud.hover: How much more the jet feeds the tone at a full breath. Range -3 to 3 octaves.

y0.label: Edge offset
y0.hover: Where the jet aims at the edge, relative to its thickness: off-centre adds even harmonics. Range -5 to 5.

y_tilt.label: Aim by timbre
y_tilt.hover: How far timbre moves the jet's aim. Range -3 to 3.

jet_st.label: Jet bandwidth
jet_st.hover: How high the jet responds: lower is smoother. Range 0.01 to 1.

vortex.label: Edge losses
vortex.hover: The losses at the edge: larger is less loss and a freer tone. Range 0.1 to 5.

bore_mm.label: Bore radius
bore_mm.hover: How wide the tube is. Range 2 to 20 mm.

bore_decay.label: Bore decay
bore_decay.hover: How long the tube's resonance rings: the bloom and the tail. Range 0.002 to 0.5 s.

bore_reg.label: Bore by register
bore_reg.hover: How much shorter the tube's ring gets per octave up. Range -1 to 2 octaves.

cut_hz.label: Tone-hole cutoff
cut_hz.hover: The frequency above which the open tone holes stop reflecting: the flute tone's brightness. Range 200 to 12000 Hz.

wall.label: Wall losses
wall.hover: How much the tube's walls soak up: higher is darker and softer. Range 0.5 to 50.

disp.label: End correction
disp.hover: A tuning correction of the tube's open end: 0 none. Range -0.9 to 0.9.

cover.label: Cover pitch
cover.hover: How far covering the embouchure hole (timbre up) flattens the pitch. Range -200 to 200 cents.

cover_hz.label: Cover darkness
cover_hz.hover: How much covering the embouchure hole darkens the tone. Range -2 to 2 octaves.

low_note.label: Lowest note
low_note.hover: The instrument's lowest note: the first register starts here. Range 24 to 96 MIDI note.

overblow.label: Overblow
overblow.hover: Whether the second and third octaves are overblown (on) or every note plays on the fundamental (off). Range off or on.

range_lo.label: Range, low
range_lo.hover: The bottom of the fitted range; notes below keep the lowest note's playing. Range 24 to 96 MIDI note.

range_hi.label: Range, high
range_hi.hover: The top of the fitted range; notes above play on a short pipe's fundamental. Range 48 to 120 MIDI note.

g_out.label: Gain out of range
g_out.hover: How surely notes above the range speak at the lightest touch. Range 1 to 6.

out_db.label: Level out of range
out_db.hover: The level of notes above the range, relative to the fitted ones. Range -24 to 6 dB.

ob_amt.label: Overblow drive
ob_amt.hover: How much a hard breath pushes the note into the next register: 0 never. Range 0 to 1.

ob_thr.label: Overblow from
ob_thr.hover: The breath where overblowing starts. Range 0 to 1.5.

mouth.label: Embouchure radiation
mouth.hover: How much sound comes from the embouchure hole. Range 0 to 4.

end.label: End radiation
end.hover: How much sound comes from the open end and tone holes. Range 0 to 4.

dipole.label: Edge tone
dipole.hover: How much of the jet's own edge tone you hear directly. Range 0 to 4.

tone_hz.label: Tone
tone_hz.hover: The brightness of the radiated tone: the frequency above which it rolls off. Range 500 to 16000 Hz.

tone_q.label: Tone sharpness
tone_q.hover: How sharp the tone roll-off is. Range 0.5 to 2.

turb.label: Turbulence
turb.hover: The turbulence in the air stream. Range 0 to 2.

turb_hz.label: Turbulence bandwidth
turb_hz.hover: How high the turbulence reaches. Range 100 to 12000 Hz.

hiss.label: Hiss
hiss.hover: The steady hiss of the air. Range 0 to 1.

hiss_st.label: Hiss pitch
hiss_st.hover: Where the hiss sits, as a Strouhal number of the jet. Range 0.02 to 1.

t_noise.label: Tongue "t"
t_noise.hover: The short noise burst of a tongued start. Range 0 to 3.

tongue.label: Strike
tongue.hover: How much a hard strike sharpens the start: the tongue's hold and release, the accent and the "t". Range 0 to 2.

acc_level.label: Accent
acc_level.hover: The extra push at the start of a struck note: 0 none, higher is a sharper attack. Range 0 to 1.5.

acc_decay.label: Accent length
acc_decay.hover: How long the accent lasts before the note settles. Range 0.005 to 0.3 s.

tongue_t.label: Tongue release
tongue_t.hover: How long the tongue takes to let the note go on a soft start; a hard strike is many times faster. Range 0.0005 to 0.1 s.

att_gain.label: Attack jet
att_gain.hover: How much faster and thinner the jet starts after the tongue's release. Range 0 to 40.

att_t.label: Attack jet length
att_t.hover: How long the fast, thin starting jet lasts. Range 0.005 to 0.15 s.

att_soft.label: Attack without a strike
att_soft.hover: How much of the fast start a breath attack or a slur still gets. Range 0 to 1.

slur.label: Slur
slur.hover: How much articulation a legato note change gets: 0 seamless, 1 each new note is re-tongued. Range 0 to 1.

pitch_t.label: Pitch settling
pitch_t.hover: How fast the player's ear pulls the pitch to its centre after a start or a change. Range 0.002 to 1 s.

vib.label: Vibrato by shake
vib.hover: How much breath vibrato a shake (the motion input) adds. Range 0 to 2.

vib_hz.label: Vibrato rate
vib_hz.hover: How fast the vibrato wavers. Range 2 to 9 Hz.

tongue_nz.label: Tongue noise by strike
tongue_nz.hover: How much of the strike goes into the "t" noise at the start. Range 0 to 2.

tongue_rt.label: Tongue speed by strike
tongue_rt.hover: How much a hard strike quickens the tongue's release. Range 0 to 2.

tongue_sus.label: Swell accent
tongue_sus.hover: How much accent and noise a swell within a held note gets: the texture of the sustain. Range 0 to 2.
